actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.hackernews_get_item.description: Gets a Hacker News story, comment, job, poll or poll option by its id.
actions.hackernews_get_item.props.itemId: The numeric id of the item, e.g. 8863.
actions.hackernews_get_max_item_id.descr: Gets the id of the newest item on Hacker News.
actions.hackernews_get_updates.descripti: Gets the items and user profiles that changed recently on Hacker News.
actions.hackernews_get_user.description: Gets a Hacker News user profile by username.
actions.hackernews_get_user.props.userna: The case-sensitive Hacker News username, e.g. "pg".
actions.hackernews_list_ask_stories.desc: Lists the latest Ask HN posts, with full details.
actions.hackernews_list_ask_stories.prop: How many stories to return, from the top of the list (1-100). Defaults to 10.
actions.hackernews_list_best_stories.des: Lists the best recent Hacker News stories, with full details.
actions.hackernews_list_best_stories.pro: How many stories to return, from the top of the list (1-100). Defaults to 10.
actions.hackernews_list_job_stories.desc: Lists the latest Hacker News job posts, with full details.
actions.hackernews_list_job_stories.prop: How many stories to return, from the top of the list (1-100). Defaults to 10.
actions.hackernews_list_new_stories.desc: Lists the newest Hacker News stories, with full details.
actions.hackernews_list_new_stories.prop: How many stories to return, from the top of the list (1-100). Defaults to 10.
actions.hackernews_list_show_stories.des: Lists the latest Show HN posts, with full details.
actions.hackernews_list_show_stories.pro: How many stories to return, from the top of the list (1-100). Defaults to 10.
actions.hackernews_list_top_stories.desc: Lists the stories on the Hacker News front page, with full details.
actions.hackernews_list_top_stories.prop: How many stories to return, from the top of the list (1-100). Defaults to 10.
